# bronto Provider

Manage [Bronto](https://bronto.io) resources as code: users, dashboards, widgets, metric definitions, and Slack/webhook integrations.

Multiple orgs (e.g. a root org and a child org, each with their own API key) can be managed from one configuration by declaring multiple aliased instances of this provider and pointing each resource at the right one with `provider = bronto.<alias>` - see the example below.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bronto = {
      source = "brontoio/bronto"
    }
  }
}

provider "bronto" {
  # endpoint and api_key can also be supplied via the BRONTO_ENDPOINT and
  # BRONTO_API_KEY environment variables.
  endpoint = "https://api.eu.bronto.io"
  api_key  = var.bronto_api_key
}

# Managing multiple orgs (e.g. a root org and a child org, each with their
# own API key) from one configuration: declare multiple aliased instances
# and point each resource at the right one with provider = bronto.<alias>.
provider "bronto" {
  alias    = "root"
  endpoint = var.bronto_endpoint
  api_key  = var.root_org_api_key
}

provider "bronto" {
  alias    = "child"
  endpoint = var.bronto_endpoint
  api_key  = var.child_org_api_key
}

resource "bronto_user" "example" {
  provider = bronto.root
  # ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key used to authenticate with the Bronto API. Can also be set via the `BRONTO_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) The base URL of the Bronto API to use, e.g. `https://api.eu.bronto.io`. Can also be set via the `BRONTO_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
